result.topic_en: Calculations on gas dynamics: the continuity and Euler equations of fluid motion in spherical and planar polar coordinates, adiabatic pressure–density relations, heat and specific heats of gases, kinetic-theory pressure, and a two-body gravitational orbit calculation.
